name: Cosmic Brief (Horoscopes) — weekly episode (front-end for the YakYak engine)

parameters.content:
## 📄 YakYak Description — workflow summary (not a step note)
Every Sunday at UTC 06:00 a reading is computed for each of the twelve zodiac signs from the calendar week. The forecasts are dramatized and rendered as a celestial digital painting.

nodes.name: Every Sunday
nodes.notes: 06:00 UTC Sundays — CADENCE=weekly in show/Horoscopes/show.env (the showrunner planner runs weekly shows on Sundays). Use 'Test workflow' to fire a run by hand.

nodes.name: Show config
nodes.notes: ALL per-show config lives here, on the canvas — the workflow reads no environment variables. Required: campaignId (a campaign the API credential's account owns) and userId (for the balance check). Optional: soundtrackAudioPath (empty = skip the pin), chatWebhookUrl (empty = no announcement). No Anthropic credential needed — this show is fully computed.

nodes.name: Fetch user
nodes.notes: Same 'YakYak API' Bearer credential as the engine — no token on the canvas or in env. onError=continue so Balance guard can report a clear error instead of a bare 404.

nodes.name: Compute story
nodes.notes: The whole story stage: deterministic, offline, model-free. This node replaces the three fetch nodes + Claude call of the prompt-sourced shows.

nodes.name: Build story payload
nodes.notes: The story markdown is preserved on this node's output — n8n's execution log is the story archive (the showrunner's stories/ equivalent).

nodes.name: Call engine

workflowId.cachedResultName: YakYak engine — resolve target, patch or new episode, render, post

nodes.notes: Fires the generic YakYak engine in episode mode. The engine only responds once the episode is generated AND rendered. Retry is safe: a re-run lands on the same unrendered slot. Announcement happens here (below), not in the engine. A Cosmic Brief episode is 14 scenes (💸) — the weekly cadence keeps the spend predictable.

nodes.name: Set social fields

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ Object.assign({ movieId: $json.movieId }, $('Build story payload').first().json.socialTitle ? { socialTitle: $('Build story payload').first().json.socialTitle } : {}, $('Build story payload').first().json.socialCaption ? { socialDescription: $('Build story payload').first().json.socialCaption } : {}) }}

nodes.notes: Showrunner parity: ≤50-char social title + caption. onError=continue — cosmetic metadata must not kill a rendered episode.

nodes.name: Announce

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { text: '✨ Cosmic Brief episode ready — "' + ($('Build story payload').first().json.socialTitle || 'Weekly horoscopes') + '": ' + $('Call engine').first().json.url } }}

nodes.notes: Review-first output event (the safe default). chatWebhookUrl empty → this node errors and the run still succeeds (onError=continue). Auto-posting to social is the deliberate next step — see the BBN guide §4.3.
